purpose: test-only certificate for immutable template/node lookup, owner replay and complete retained outer-frame projection

captured_template.lookup_rule: resolve the exact pair (handle,node_index) against the immutable ResumeTemplate stored by the owning machine; require the resolved node to be TemplateNode::Owner and preserve every traversed root/inner edge

owner_replay.rule: the actual immutable node lookup, control-map resolution, branch disposition, chosen owner and pushed OwnerReturn must form one ordered source-derived replay

frame_projection.rule: retain complete ordered projection with explicit source-derived endpoints and mandatory connected boundaries; saved suffix and retained outer frames are distinct projections

request_consumer.rule: link the captured template through replay and the complete outer projection to the distinct write operation's actual receiving consumer; permission, request creation, consumer handling and residual flow remain distinct

mutations.rule: a mutation is invalid evidence unless it proves that the intended target existed and the applicable certificate record changed before rejection is asserted

authority: test-only observations and validators; no runtime semantics, source fixture, expected output, production implementation, source-domain, dependency or theorem-scope change
